plugins/pstack/skills/poteto-mode/SKILL..why: Carries four rules from Michael Denyer's pstack-claude in T3 wording: load a managed platform's skill before deploying, stop an abandoned agent with task_cancel and confirm with task_status that it stopped, keep a review gate closed while no independent reviewer can run, and keep the todolist in .audit/<task-slug>.todo.md when the session has no task tool.

plugins/pstack/skills/poteto-mode/playbo.why: Carries the rule from Michael Denyer's pstack-claude that every file-writing delegate gets its own worktree from HEAD and that no one writes or runs a suite in a worktree a delegate still holds.
Carries the rule from Michael Denyer's pstack-claude that every live agent holding a worktree is stopped, and the stop confirmed, before a commit, merge, or deploy from it.
Adds --match-head-commit <verified-head> to the GitHub merge in step 4, the head guard from Michael Denyer's pstack-claude, so a head pushed after verification cannot land.

plugins/pstack/skills/poteto-mode/script.why: Expects the --settle default that cli.ts adds.
Adds the --settle option (default 300 seconds, 0 disables) that the T3 settle overlay in settle.ts reads.
Gives the fake reader the reviewActivity method the settle overlay adds to GitHubReader.
Gives the gh reader the reviewActivity method that settle.ts uses to read review activity and the head's push time.
Sets settle: 0 on the shared PollingOptions, so the upstream tests run with the settle overlay off.
Holds READY while settle.ts reports the PR settling, in single and stack mode, and turns that wait into a review-settling reason.
Prints the settle column in the status table and the review-settling WAITING and TIMEOUT lines from settle.ts.
Adds the settle state to an open PR snapshot, the settling decision and wait reason, and the reviewActivity reader method that settle.ts defines.

plugins/pstack/skills/setup-pstack/SKILL.why: Writes the T3 model sheet from orchestrator_capabilities targets and checks it with t3-sheet.mjs, in place of Cursor's always-applied .mdc rule built from model slugs.
